In the following several months after the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] sacrificed his [[Jax Pavan's lightsaber|lightsaber]] to escape [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and briefly making use of a [[Jax Pavan's lightwhip|lightwhip]], he replaced his weapon with a '''[[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]]''' that had a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] blade that was woven with [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] making it resistant to blaster fire. However, a blaster bolt could short out the swords vibrogenerator if a bolt hit the lower part of the blade near the hilt. Jax kept the sword in a sheath. Pavan didn't much like the sword considering it useless and finding blaster fire hard to deflect. He used the vibrosword during an encounter with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] while helping Undersecretary [[Varesk Bura'lya]] escape [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] through the [[Whiplash]]. Jax was later handed a [[Jax Pavan's Velmorian energy sword|Velmorian energy sword]] by [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]] to use while Rhinann tried looking for materials and components to build a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for him.<ref name="CNII:SOS" /> Following the [[Ambush near the Twins|ambush]] near the [[Twins (star system)/Legends|Twins]], Jax Pavan escaped the crashing [[Far Ranger]] with only his [[Jax Pavan’s third lightsaber|third lightsaber]], [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing's]] old [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]], his [[Miisai|miisai tree]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]] [[SD41263.I]].<ref name="Last Jedi">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>
